title: Vacuum energy secrecy to prevent weaponization

tellings.quote:
what if the
government discovered that it's not that
hard after all
to to access the physical vacuum and
extract energy from it.

plain: The idea is that the US government may have found out that it is "not that hard after all" to pull energy out of the physical vacuum, the seemingly empty background of space, and then kept it secret so the discovery could not be turned into a weapon. A researcher and former Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell offers this as a what-if, without naming a source, and links it to the work of the inventors Nikola Tesla and T. T. Brown. If it were true, a nearly limitless energy source would exist and be hidden on purpose.
